value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Hesperia.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value: Schedule via the city's automated phone system: 760-947-1300
Systems over 15kW require an additional roof mount inspection before panel installation
All required documents must be available during inspection

value.notes: The city states applicants receive a City of Hesperia-issued permit within 2 business days of SolarAPP+ approval.

other_conditions: Rooftop installations only; no ground-mount or ballasted systems
No existing PV panels or battery storage on the structure
Structure cannot be historic or within a Historic Preservation District
Structure must be legal, permitted, and code compliant

permit_fees.notes: The page states applicants must pay the SolarAPP+ processing fee plus applicable City of Hesperia fees, but does not state specific dollar amounts.
